description: Route the unrouted connections as ONE change: the whole board, or only some nets, parts or one instance (one of these). Run it after placing; unplaced parts get no copper; existing copper is kept. It names each connection it could not route and why: route those with route_track, or move parts and run it again.

instance.description: e.g. "PS1"; copied to its sheet's other instances placed alike

name: autoroute
